Name: To The Moon
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53346/53346-1791065100-1267344284.png[/img][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]A mod that allows you to go to the moon, granting access to a challenging new farm and cave system. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53346/53346-1791065111-1103964577.png[/img][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]4 New Winter Crops[/*]
[*]A Crystal Fruit Bush[/*]
[*]1 New Winter Fruit Tree[/*]
[*]A New Mushroom Tree[/*]
[*]Radiation Shields[/*]
[*]A Mini-Teleporter to Ship Items from the Moon[/*]
[*]A Specialized Furnace[/*]
[*]3 New Fish (one of which is a legendary fish)[/*]
[*]New Monsters[/*]
[*]New Ores[/*]
[*]3 New Cooking Recipes[/*]
[*]A Research System[/*]
[*]New Special Orders[/*]
[*]Cheese[/*]
[*]An Option to Switch to a More Science-Fantasy as opposed to a more sci-fi experience (Work in Progress)[/*]
[*]And More![/*]
[/list]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53346/53346-1791065130-836780371.png[/img][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Mechanically, the moon farm operates as though it is always in winter. However, you can grow crops from other seasons (or even speed up the growth of winter crops) by using radiation shields. In addition to this, various items (primarily items that produce fire) cannot be placed on the moon. A full list is provided below.[/size][/color]
[spoiler][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Torches[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Crab Pots[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Jack-O-Lanterns[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Cookout Kits[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Tents[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Bombs[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Bee Houses[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Furnaces[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Garden Pots[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Charcoal Kilns[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Braziers[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Worm Bins/Bait Makers[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Mini-Shipping Bin[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Junimo Chests[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Campfires[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Heavy Furnaces[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Fish Smokers[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
Furthermore, you must wear the space helmet if you want to prevent blindness and nausea, and space boots if you want to prevent a slowness debuff while on the moon. Both of these can be disabled in the settings.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53346/53346-1791064386-843947556.png[/img]
[b]The Rocket Ship (Building)[/b]
After completing the community center or JojaMart and seeing the MarILDA cutscene*, you will get a letter from Maru asking you to visit the town square for some important news regarding a recent discovery...

*Note - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50060]A Small Maru Expansion[/url] causes this cutscene to occur when reaching 8 hearts with Maru. If you have already seen this event or are planning on dating/marrying Maru, then you can ignore this mod requirement.

[b]The New Seeds[/b]
Most of the new seeds can be obtained from meteors. Fortunately the moon is a hot spot for meteors!

[b]Research[/b]
The moon base has a terminal connected to MarILDA. As you ship objects, more research options will become available to you. This ranges from new insights to the ability to further process these alien crops.

[b]Fish Ponds[/b]
In order for Jellysquids and Reapers to be able to live in a fish pond and produce roe, you will need to research how to process them. Due to how the game works, you can place Jellysquids and Reapers in a fish pond before this happens. You MUST empty these ponds after researching their respective fish in order for the changes to occur.

[b]The Mini-Teleporter/Radiation Shields/Astro Furnace[/b]
All of these can be obtained via special orders that become available after visiting the moon for the first time!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53346/53346-1791066317-244113619.png[/img]
